The '''Taurus Helment''' is a {{Rare}} [[Helmet]], which is obtainable as a drop from the [[Taurus]] [[Sea Creatures|Sea Creature]]. It reduces damage from {{MobType|Magmatic}} mobs by {{Green|5%}}, and increases damage against them by {{Red|1.1x}}.
